name: dno-rebuild
description: TypeScript rebuild of the DNO core flow: party, catalog, pricing, tax, ordering, inventory, billing, payment, dunning.

scripts.build: npm run build -w nest && npm run build -w portal-vue
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test -w nest
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p backend && npm run typecheck -w nest && npm run typecheck -w portal-vue
